title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Music Hall on 1971-04-07

ai_review.summary: Great soundboard capture of an in‑tune, high‑energy set.

The performance is described as “great,” indicating a lively show despite the lack of specific song mentions. Overall the tape offers an enjoyable listening experience with no reported technical flaws.
